question: A race track is in the shape of a ring whose inner and outer circumferences are 880 m and 1012 m, respectively. What is the area (in m²) of the track? (Take π = frac{{22}}{7})
solution:
**Given:**

The inner circumferences = 880 m

The outer circumferences = 1012

**Formula used:**

The circumferences of a circle = 2 × π × Radius

The area of a circle = π × (Radius)²

**Calculation:**

Let, inner radius = r and Outer radius = R

So, 2 × (22/7) × r = 880 ⇒ r = 880 × (7/22) × (1/2) = 140 m

Also, 2 × (22/7) × R = 1012 ⇒ R = 1012 × (7/22) × (1/2) = 161 m

The area of the track = [(22/7) × (161)²] - [(22/7) × (140)²]

= (22/7) (25921 - 19600)

= (22/7) × 6321

= 19866 m2

**∴ The area (in m2) of the track is 19866 m2**
